mainTopic: Does our משנה include disputed cases? רבי שמעון on אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, and how far רב's 'in all of them' reaches
overview: Our משנה lists fifteen women who exempt their co-wives from יבום, and the גמרא is checking whether that list includes only cases everyone agrees on. First it points to אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, a case רבי שמעון and רבנן argue about. It answers that when the younger brother was born before the יבום, even רבי שמעון agrees. A statement of רבי אושעיא saying otherwise is pushed aside because it was already refuted. Then the גמרא brings רב's rule: in all the cases of the משנה, you can set up two sisters where each is forbidden to one brother but permitted to the other. רב יהודה says this works only from חמותו onward, since the first six cases need אונס and the משנה deals with marriage. אביי includes even a daughter born through אונס, but leaves out אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, because that setup only works according to רבי שמעון. רב ספרא includes even that case, building it with six brothers according to רבי שמעון.

steps.title: Finishing the challenge: a disputed case is taught in the משנה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא completes its challenge. אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו is a case where רבי שמעון and רבנן disagree, and yet our משנה teaches it.
steps.simpleTranslation: There is a case where רבי שמעון and the רבנן disagree, and yet the משנה teaches it!
steps.whatsHappening: This line is the end of a question that began just before this point. The גמרא points out that our משנה includes a case that רבי שמעון and רבנן argue about.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The guess being tested is that our משנה only lists cases that everyone agrees on. The case of אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו seems to break that rule, because רבי שמעון disagrees with רבנן about it. If the משנה still teaches it, then it does include disputed cases.

keyTerms.meaning: That they disagree
The Sages, meaning the majority opinion
And yet it teaches (it in the משנה)

phrases.english: Where Rabbi Shimon and the Rabbis disagree, and yet it is taught!
phrases.notes: This is the end of a question about אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו: a brother's wife, where the two brothers were never alive at the same time.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the challenge the גמרא began just before this point.
steps.kashyaTarget: The idea that our משנה lists only undisputed cases.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו is argued about by רבי שמעון and רבנן, but the משנה lists it anyway.

steps.title: In the case where he was born before the יבום, רבי שמעון agrees
steps.stepSummary: The answer: there is a version of the case where רבי שמעון does not argue. The younger brother was born first, and only afterward the other brother did יבום. The משנה can be talking about that version.
steps.simpleTranslation: Where he was born and only afterward the brother did יבום, רבי שמעון does not disagree.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge. It points to one version of the case where even רבי שמעון agrees with רבנן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון only argues when the יבום happened before the youngest brother was born. If the youngest brother was already alive when another brother did יבום, and that brother later died, רבי שמעון agrees the woman is forbidden to him. So the משנה can be talking about that version, and it still lists only agreed-upon cases.

keyTerms.meaning: Was born
And afterward, at the end
Did יבום, married his late brother's widow
Does not disagree

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think רבי שמעון is giving up his whole view. He still argues when the יבום happened before the youngest brother was born. He only agrees in this one order of events.

phrases.english: Where he was born and afterward [the other brother] did yibum —
Rabbi Shimon does not disagree.

steps.triggerLanguage: בְּנוֹלַד וּלְבַסּוֹף יִיבֵּם לָא פְּלִיג רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge by narrowing which version of the case the משנה means.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Narrowing the case to a version that everyone agrees on.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: We thought רבי שמעון argues in every version of אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו.
steps.terutzMaskana: רבי שמעון agrees when the brother was born before the יבום, so the משנה can still list only undisputed cases.

steps.title: רבי אושעיא says רבי שמעון argued even in the first case
steps.stepSummary: A challenge to the answer: רבי אושעיא said that רבי שמעון disagreed even in the first case, where the brother was born before the יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: But didn't רבי אושעיא say that רבי שמעון disagreed even in the first case?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks the answer it just gave. It quotes רבי אושעיא, who says רבי שמעון argues even when the brother was born first.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The answer in step 2 depended on רבי שמעון agreeing in the 'born first' version. רבי אושעיא says he does not agree there either. If that is true, every version of the case is disputed, and the original challenge comes back.

keyTerms.meaning: But didn't (he) say? This opens a challenge.
Disagreeing, holding a different view
Even in the first (case)

phrases.english: But didn't Rabbi Oshaya say:
Rabbi Shimon disagreed
even in the first [case]!
phrases.notes: The 'first case' is the one from step 2: he was born first, and the יבום happened afterward.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the answer given in step 2.
steps.kashyaTarget: The claim that רבי שמעון agrees in the 'born first, then יבום' case.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי אושעיא says רבי שמעון argues there too, so no version of the case is free of dispute.

steps.title: רבי אושעיא's statement was refuted
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brushes off the challenge. רבי אושעיא's statement was already refuted, so the answer in step 2 still holds.
steps.simpleTranslation: But רבי אושעיא was already refuted.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא rejects the challenge. It says רבי אושעיא's view was already shown to be wrong, so we do not have to follow it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since רבי אושעיא was refuted elsewhere, his statement cannot be used against the answer. So רבי שמעון does agree in the 'born first' version, and we can still say the משנה lists only undisputed cases.

keyTerms.meaning: But, here: this introduces a pushback
Was refuted, his view was knocked down

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה can be talking about אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו where the brother was born before the יבום. In that version even רבי שמעון agrees, because רבי אושעיא's contrary statement was refuted.

phrases.english: But Rabbi Oshaya was refuted.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge from רבי אושעיא and keeps the answer of step 2.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The whole challenge built on רבי אושעיא's statement.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The challenge rests on a view that was already refuted, so it has no force.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: It is still possible to say the משנה teaches only undisputed cases.

steps.title: רב's rule: in all the cases, each sister is forbidden to one brother and permitted to the other
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a statement of רב יהודה in the name of רב, also taught by רבי חייא. In all the cases of the משנה, you can build a case where two sisters are each forbidden to one brother but permitted to another, so each does חליצה or יבום.
steps.simpleTranslation: But didn't רב יהודה say in the name of רב, and רבי חייא taught the same: In all of these cases I can describe a woman forbidden to this brother but permitted to that one, and another forbidden to this one but permitted to that one, and her sister who is her יבמה does חליצה or יבום.
steps.whatsHappening: The word 'וְהָאָמַר' ('but didn't he say') tells us the גמרא is bringing a source to push back on the idea that our משנה lists only undisputed cases. רב's rule covers ALL the cases of our משנה, including one that seems to work only according to רבי שמעון. The next lines explain how far 'all of them' really goes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Picture two sisters married to two brothers who both died. Sister A is an ערוה (forbidden relative) to one living brother but not to the other, and Sister B is the reverse. Each sister is permitted to one of the brothers, so each can do חליצה or יבום. רב says you can build this setup out of every case in the משנה, and that 'every' would include אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, which (as step 11 shows) only works according to רבי שמעון.

keyTerms.meaning: But didn't he say? This introduces a source that challenges what came before.
The one forbidden to this brother is permitted to that brother.
Her sister-in-law. Here it means a fellow widow waiting for יבום from the same family.
Does חליצה, or marries the brother through יבום.

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think one woman is both forbidden and permitted to the same brother. There are two sisters and two brothers. Each sister is forbidden to a different brother.

phrases.english: But didn't Rav Yehuda say in the name of Rav,
and so too Rabbi Chiya taught:
Regarding all of them, I can describe them as
phrases.notes: 'All of them' means all the women listed in our משנה.

phrases.english: the one forbidden to this brother is permitted to that brother,
and the one forbidden to this brother is permitted to that brother,
phrases.notes: This line is about the second sister, who is forbidden to the other brother.

phrases.english: and her sister, who is her fellow sister-in-law,
does חליצה or יבום.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָאָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב, וְכֵן תָּנֵי רַבִּי חִיָּיא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After step 4 kept the idea that the משנה lists only undisputed cases, the גמרא challenges it again with רב's statement that 'all' the cases, including אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, can produce the two-sisters setup.
steps.kashyaTarget: The conclusion of steps 2–4 that our משנה lists only undisputed cases.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רב says every case in the משנה, including אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, can produce the two-sisters setup. For that case the setup works only according to רבי שמעון, so the משנה would be built on a disputed view. The אמוראים who follow (רב יהודה, אביי, רב ספרא) each explain how far 'all of them' really reaches.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up the important distinction between אונס and נישואין that comes next.

steps.title: רב יהודה limits the rule to cases from mother-in-law onward
steps.stepSummary: רב יהודה explains that 'all of them' really means from חמותו onward. It does not include the first six cases of the משנה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רב יהודה explains: from 'his mother-in-law' and onward. But the first six cases, no.
steps.whatsHappening: רב יהודה narrows the rule he just quoted. 'All' does not really mean all. It starts from the case of חמותו.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה's list opens with six cases: בתו, בת בתו, בת בנו, בת אשתו, בת בנה, בת בתה. רב יהודה says the two-sisters setup does not work for these six. It only works for the cases from חמותו and on.

keyTerms.meaning: Explains, interprets.
From the case of his mother-in-law and onward.
The first six cases (literally, 'the six sections at the beginning').

phrases.english: And Rav Yehuda explains it as
from 'his mother-in-law' and onward.
But the first six cases, no.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Narrows the 'all of them' in step 5.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The setup of 'forbidden to this, permitted to that' applies only from חמותו onward, not to the first six cases.

steps.title: Why not the first six cases?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the reason behind רב יהודה's limit.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a short question to set up the next step: why can't the first six cases work?
steps.deeperAnalysis: Nothing new is decided here. The גמרא simply wants the logic behind leaving out the first six cases, and the answer comes next.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the reason?

phrases.english: What is the reason?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the reason behind step 6.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the first six cases cannot produce the two-sisters setup.

steps.title: The daughter case only works through אונס, but the משנה deals with marriage
steps.stepSummary: A case like בתו can only produce this setup through אונס, not through marriage. Our משנה is talking about marriage, so those six cases are left out.
steps.simpleTranslation: Because with 'his daughter', you can find the case through אונס, but you can't find it through marriage. And the משנה deals with marriage, not with אונס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question. The first six cases only work if a child was born through אונס, and our משנה is not talking about that.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Take the case of a daughter. For two sisters to each be the daughter of a different brother, their shared mother would need children from two brothers. If she was married to one brother, she is forbidden to the other as אשת אח. Only through אונס, where no marriage-based prohibition applies, can this happen. Since the משנה speaks of נישואין, these six cases are left out.

keyTerms.meaning: Cases of rape, where there was no marriage.
Marriage.
You can find (such a case).
It is dealing with, it is talking about.

steps.whatToRemember: According to רב יהודה, רב's rule that each sister is 'forbidden to this, permitted to that' works only from חמותו onward. The first six cases need אונס to work, and our משנה deals only with marriage. אביי disagrees in the next step.

phrases.english: Since, regarding his daughter,
you can find it in cases of rape,
but in marriage you cannot find it.
phrases.notes: If the mother married one brother, she is forbidden to the other brother, so she can't have daughters from both.

phrases.english: It (the משנה) deals with marriage,
it does not deal with rape.

steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The first six cases can only produce the setup through אונס, and the משנה deals only with marriage.
steps.whyThisMatters: It teaches that the cases in our משנה are understood as cases of marriage, and this shapes which setups the משנה can include.

steps.title: אביי includes even a daughter born through rape
steps.stepSummary: אביי explains 'in all of them' more broadly than רב יהודה. He includes even בתו מאנוסתו, since the case can be found either way. He leaves out only אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו.
steps.simpleTranslation: And אביי explains: even his daughter from a woman he raped is included. Since the case can be found at all, it does not matter whether it comes through אונס or through נישואין. But the wife of a brother who was not alive at the same time as him is not included.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי gives a different explanation from רב יהודה about which cases in the משנה can produce the two-sisters setup. He includes the cases that רב יהודה had left out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רב יהודה excluded cases like בתו because they only work through אונס, while our משנה is about marriage. אביי says that does not matter: as long as the setup can be found, by rape or by marriage, the case counts. He does exclude one case, אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, and the גמרא will now ask why.

keyTerms.meaning: Explains or interprets (here: explains the statement 'in all of them')
The woman he raped
You can find it at all, meaning the case is possible
Marriage
The wife of a brother who died before he was born

steps.confusionAlert: אביי is not arguing about the law of the משנה. He is arguing about how far the statement 'in all of them' reaches, meaning which cases can produce the two-sisters setup.

phrases.english: And Abaye explains
phrases.notes: He is explaining 'in all of them' from step 5 in a different way than רב יהודה did.

phrases.english: even his daughter from the woman he raped is included
since you can find the case at all
if you want, let it be through rape
if you want, let it be through marriage.
phrases.notes: Some versions don't have these words; the square brackets show they belong in the corrected wording.

phrases.aramaic: אֲבָל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּעוֹלָמוֹ
phrases.english: But the wife of his brother who was not in the world with him
is not included.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a different reading from רב יהודה's limit (steps 6 and 8), widening the list of cases that are included.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: 'In all of them' includes even בתו מאנוסתו, but not אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו.

steps.title: Why does אביי leave out the brother's wife?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why אביי excludes אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why אביי, who includes almost every case, leaves out this one. This question sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי's rule was simple: if the case can be found, it counts. So why would this case not count? The גמרא wants to know what makes it different.

keyTerms.meaning: What is the reason?

phrases.english: What is the reason?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the reason behind the one exception in אביי's statement.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why אביי excludes אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו from 'in all of them'.

steps.title: That case only works according to רבי שמעון
steps.stepSummary: The setup can only be found according to רבי שמעון, not according to the רבנן. The משנה does not deal with disputed cases.
steps.simpleTranslation: Since it is only according to רבי שמעון that you can find this case, and according to the רבנן you cannot find it, it is left out. The משנה is not talking about a disputed case.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that this case only works under רבי שמעון's opinion. The משנה only counts cases that everyone agrees can happen.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי's rule was 'if you can find it, it counts.' But here you can only find it if you follow רבי שמעון, so the רבנן would say the case never happens. Since the משנה does not build on disputed opinions, this case stays out.

keyTerms.meaning: The Sages, meaning the majority opinion
A dispute
Is talking about, deals with

steps.whyThisMatters: It shows a general rule for reading a משנה: a list in a משנה is assumed to include only cases that all opinions accept.

phrases.english: Since it is only according to Rabbi Shimon
that you can find this case,
phrases.notes: רבי שמעון permits her to a brother born after the remaining brother already did יבום with her. That is how the setup can happen.

phrases.english: and according to the Rabbis you cannot find it,
the Mishnah does not deal with a disputed case.

steps.triggerLanguage: כֵּיוָן דִּלְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן הוּא דְּמַשְׁכַּחַתְּ לַהּ
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The case is possible only according to רבי שמעון, and the משנה does not deal with disputed cases.

steps.title: רב ספרא includes even the brother's wife
steps.stepSummary: רב ספרא includes even אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו. He builds the case with six brothers, following רבי שמעון.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רב ספרא explains: even the wife of a brother who was not alive at the same time as him is included. You can find this case with six brothers, according to רבי שמעון.
steps.whatsHappening: רב ספרא gives a third explanation and goes further than אביי. He includes even the case that אביי left out.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי excluded this case because it depends on רבי שמעון. רב ספרא is not bothered by that. He says the setup can be built with six brothers following רבי שמעון's opinion, so the case is included too.

keyTerms.meaning: Six brothers
According to the opinion of

steps.whatToRemember: There are three views on 'in all of them.' רב יהודה counts only from חמותו onward. אביי includes even בתו מאנוסתו but not אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו. רב ספרא includes even that case, using six brothers according to רבי שמעון.

phrases.english: And Rav Safra explains

phrases.aramaic: אַף אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה בְּעוֹלָמוֹ,
phrases.english: that even the wife of his brother who was not in the world with him is included,
and you can find this case with six brothers,
and it follows the opinion of Rabbi Shimon.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Disagrees with אביי's exclusion (step 11) and includes even אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: 'In all of them' includes even אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, which can be found with six brothers according to רבי שמעון.
